notes.subject: תעננו
notes.rationale: ענה i min tupela samting: 'paitim/painim man' o 'autim tok'; KJV/JPS 'afflict us' vs narapela 'anserim yumi'

notes.subject: Yahwe
notes.rationale: Askim i go stret long Yahwe, olgeta man i singautim nem bilong em

notes.subject: askim
notes.rationale: Tupela askim stret — yu ken holim pas? yu no tok? — ol i pulim Yahwe long tok bek

translation: Bilong ol dispela samting, Yahwe, yu ken holim pas long bel bilong yu? Yu no tok nating na yu paitim yumi tumas?

tokens.gloss: yu ken holim pas long bel bilong yu
